channel.title: Morning Digest News
channel.description: Meta bets big on wearable AI, new AI agent as Zuckerberg pushes back against AI doom

item.title: Melania Trump rings New York Stock Exchange opening bell to launch new women's initiative Imperia
item.description: Melania Trump has rung the opening bell at the New York Stock Exchange to promote a new women's initiative called Imperia

item.title: Trump's Board of Peace proposes $2.45 billion blueprint to begin Gaza reconstruction
item.description: The U.S.-backed Board of Peace is proposing a six-month, $2.45 billion plan to begin reconstruction and governance in Gaza as President Donald Trump’s ceasefire plan struggles to stay afloat

item.title: FBI investigates hackers' claim to have stolen sensitive employee data, compromised jobs website
item.description: The FBI says it is investigating a criminal hacking group’s claims that it had stolen “very sensitive data” belonging to thousands of agents and applicants and that it had compromised the bureau’s jobs website

item.title: Congo is running short of health workers as Ebola remains out of control, WHO says
item.description: The World Health Organization warns that Congo is running short of health workers to staff treatment centers for the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history

item.title: Senators to question FDA nominee about her views on abortion pill and vaccines
item.description: President Donald Trump’s pick to run the Food and Drug Administration will face questions from Senate lawmakers considering her nomination

item.title: FDA panel endorses first-of-a-kind cancer blood test from Grail
item.description: A federal health panel has endorsed an experimental cancer test that uses a blood sample to detect multiple forms of the disease

item.title: Judge orders White House to restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico. Reporters still blocked
item.description: A federal judge temporarily blocked President Donald Trump’s ban of three news outlets from the White House

item.title: Federal cuts have deeply impacted residents of the Washington, DC area, a new survey shows
item.description: Federal job cuts have deeply affected the Washington, D.C. area, according to a new survey from Gallup and the Greater Washington Community Foundation

item.title: Facebook accused of deceiving users in New Mexico as trial over privacy scandal wraps up
item.description: Closing arguments have taken place in a New Mexico trial over Facebook's alleged failure to protect users from a third-party quiz that harvested data from 87 million profiles

item.title: Ugandans plant trees near national park to keep people out of gorillas’ habitat
item.description: Mountain gorillas in Uganda's Bwindi Impenetrable National Park are seeing their population grow, but their forest habitat is not expanding

item.title: Trump’s push to acquire Greenland almost broke NATO. The winner of it all may be ... Greenland
item.description: In the end, it was all kisses and laughter as U.S. President Donald Trump hailed his “fantastic” relationship with Denmark and Greenland

item.title: Tech leaders to UN: For the sake of humanity, please control the AI technology we created
item.description: The heads of major artificial intelligence firms pleaded with the United Nations to set controls over the burgeoning technology they are designing in order to save the world — or at least its people

item.title: Prince Harry warns that AI chatbots may be more dangerous than social media for young users
item.description: Prince Harry says that artificial intelligence chatbots designed to provide companionship are even more dangerous to young people than social media

item.title: Autonomous AI hacks raise thorny questions of legal accountability
item.description: The Justice Department has a long history of investigating and prosecuting hackers who break into a private company’s network

item.title: Meta bets big on wearable AI, new AI agent as Zuckerberg pushes back against AI doom
item.description: Meta is diving into AI with new wearable devices and an AI agent called Muse
